verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents explicit user-controlled deletion (CLI/API `delete` operations, confirmed working in a runtime probe) plus retention controls via `expiration_date`, webhook notifications on delete events, and self-hosted/OSS deployment for full infrastructure and data ownership with per-user API keys and audit logs. One caveat: expiration only stops surfacing memories rather than physically deleting them, so true purging relies on the separate delete API. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification that deletion permanently purges backend storage, and no explicit compliance (GDPR/right-to-be-forgotten) documentation.
